_comment: What shape each image surface crops to. Read by BOTH the renderer (domain/image_crop.py) and the builder's cropper, because a cropper locked to a different ratio than the renderer crops to is worse than no cropper -- the tenant frames a shot and the page silently discards it. Three forms: a NUMBER locks the ratio (the layout demands one -- a circular avatar is not negotiable); a LIST offers the tenant those choices; null means the surface accepts any shape and the crop defines it. "original" in a list means the source's own ratio. Adding a surface here is what makes it croppable. See plans/IMAGE_CROPPER.md.
